title: The Heirloom Yeast
logline: When an orbital greenhouse sector is foreclosed, an aging vat-tender hires an outsider to save an eighty-year-old sourdough starter before the liquidators bleach the tanks.

roles.description: Tended the orbital yeast tanks for forty years; smells of sour mash and refuses to leave without the primary culture.
A debt collector hired to liquidate biological assets; meticulous, impatient, and looking for a quick settlement.
The sealed greenhouse module where heritage starch and fungal strains are cultivated.
The station's secondary decontamination airlock where biologicals are cleared for transit.

public_situation: Bailiffs in {system} have padlocked the lower hydroponics ring, preparing to incinerate heritage cultures to satisfy an outstanding mortgage.
private_truth: The estate heir defaulted on purpose after pre-selling exclusive licensing rights to a food conglomerate, but the master culture on the tanks cannot be synthetically replicated.

beats.public_change: The foreclosure agency seals the nutrient lines and posts an eviction notice on the habitat ring.

missions.reason: The vat-tender needs thermal insulation blankets purchased from the dry docks to keep the heritage starter alive while the power mains are severed.
missions.private_fact: The tender has kept the starter alive across three corporate bankruptcies by feeding it personal ration sugar.

beats.public_change: Bailiffs disconnect the air scrubbers, forcing the vat-tender to extract the core yeast jar before the scrub cycle begins.

missions.reason: The tender needs an outsider to take custody of the sealed starter flask from the bay airlock before the bailiffs inventory the equipment.
missions.private_fact: The flask holds genetic markers that prove the strain was developed communally by station dockworkers rather than the foreclosed estate.

beats.public_change: The foreclosure agent flags the station departure queue, waiting at the secondary lock to intercept unauthorized cargo.

missions.reason: The tender asks the pilot to transport the starter flask through the quarantine lock to an independent transport waiting in the berth.
missions.private_fact: The foreclosure agent is authorized to offer a cash bribe to any courier who surrenders the sample quietly.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the living culture flask at the quarantine dock. The foreclosure agent offers to buy it for company liquidation, while the old tender pleads for it to be smuggled out to free kitchens.

options.label: Smuggle the starter out to the independent bakery cooperative
Hand the culture flask to the foreclosure agent for the cash bounty
Split the living culture between both parties to force a compromise

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the culture flask to the independent transport.
resolutions.summary: {role:vat_tender} escapes to an outer belt station where the heirloom starter feeds a network of independent bakeries.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot slipped an eighty-year-old bread starter right past the habitat bailiffs.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the culture flask to the foreclosure agent.
resolutions.summary: {role:foreclosure_agent} secures the strain for corporate patent filing, while {role:vat_tender} is left with empty pockets on the loading docks.

consequences.public_summary: A courier turned over an heirloom yeast flask to corporate patent liquidators.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot divides the yeast starter between the tender and the agent.
resolutions.summary: {role:foreclosure_agent} closes the mortgage file with half the strain, while {role:vat_tender} restarts a stunted vat in the habitat basement.

resolutions.reached_by: The starter is confiscated or the delivery is abandoned.
resolutions.summary: Bailiffs pump industrial bleach through the vats, destroying {role:vat_tender}'s life work and driving local ration bread prices up.

loose_threads.detail: The foreclosure lien was purchased by an offshore holding bank two hours before the mortgage defaulted.
Crates of industrial decontamination solvent arrived at the docks weeks before any arrears were declared.

radio_hooks: Bailiffs clear lower hydroponic bays in {system} amid contested agricultural foreclosure.
Ration bread prices tick upward across {system} stations following vat sanitization.
Independent bakers in {system} protest corporate yeast licensing fees.

voice_direction.vat_tender: Speaks slowly in raspy, measured tones, using sensory metaphors about fermentation and sourdough. Avoids speaking about money.
voice_direction.foreclosure_agent: Terse, efficient, rattling off legal paragraphs like automated inventory codes. Never acknowledges moral appeals.

title: The Counterfeit Spoilage
logline: When an agronomist fakes a catastrophic fungal blight to write off orbital grain reserves, an undercover inspector hires an outsider to intercept the smuggled harvest.

roles.description: An unsmiling food safety inspector who suspects half the system's grain surplus is being written off on paper and sold off-grid.
A brilliant greenhouse geneticist who figured out how to fake crop rot on scanner buoys to pocket the insurance payout.
The regional grain distribution monopoly that controls orbital silage silos.
An illicit distribution network that buys diverted food stores to sell at hyper-inflated prices in frontier belts.
A shielded bulk freighter running dark through asteroid alleys with stolen unblemished grain.
A massive pressurized drum station storing millions of metric bushels of freeze-dried wheat.
The disposal dock where condemned organic matter is supposedly flash-incinerated.

public_situation: Emergency phytosanitary alerts in {system} order the incineration of forty thousand tons of wheat following a reported black-rot infestation.
private_truth: The agronomist programmed sensor buoys to display false fungal spore signatures so the cartel could quietly siphon uninfected grain into ghost haulers.

beats.public_change: Agricultural safety officers lock down the primary grain silo and begin venting test chambers under yellow warning banners.

missions.reason: The inspector needs an outside pilot to fly close to the silo exhaust vents and sample the biological spore count before local officials clear the quarantine.
missions.private_fact: The inspector was already offered a quiet transfer and a five-figure bonus to rubber-stamp the disposal manifest without testing.

beats.public_change: Instead of burning the wheat, a clandestine bulk hauler slips out of the crematory slipway toward the outer jump gate.

missions.reason: The inspector needs the smuggler hauler disabled and its encrypted navigation manifests recovered before the stolen grain leaves the system.
missions.private_fact: The hauler is escorted by cartel mercenaries who were promised a twenty percent cut of the off-grid grain sale.

beats.public_change: The recovered manifest exposes the agronomist's bank accounts, but the cartel threatens to cut all food shipments to the station if charges are filed.

missions.reason: The inspector asks the pilot to courier the seized proof to the crematory security magistrate before the cartel's legal team obtains an injunction.
missions.private_fact: The agronomist is hiding inside the crematory control cabin, desperately shredding local disposal telemetry.

beats.public_change: With the evidence secured at the dock, the trust board and cartel reps arrive to negotiate the fate of the remaining silos.

missions.reason: The inspector needs the pilot to collect the agronomist's encrypted ledger from the terminal so the trustees cannot claim plausible deniability.
missions.private_fact: The food trust's senior director personally signed off on the fake blight to collect emergency state disaster subsidies.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the ledger implicating both the agronomist and the food trust. The cartel offers a fortune to erase the manifest, while the inspector demands full exposure.

options.label: Hand the unredacted ledger to the public broadcasting terminal to break the trust
Sell the ledger directly to the food trust directors in exchange for a quiet retirement payoff
Release the impounded grain directly to independent asteroid miners at cost

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the unredacted ledger.
resolutions.summary: The staged blight is exposed; {role:food_trust} directors face criminal charges while {role:rogue_agronomist} is arrested on the tarmac.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved the Great Blight was just corporate paperwork covering up stolen wheat.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the ledger to the food trust.
resolutions.summary: {role:food_trust} quietly buries the investigation; {role:farm_inspector} is reassigned to an unpopulated buoy while the cartel shares the subsidy.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot releases the grain to the miners.
resolutions.summary: The stolen wheat is distributed across belt outposts; miners celebrate cheap flour while {role:food_trust} and {role:black_market_cartel} both swear revenge.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot drops the contract or fails the interception.
resolutions.summary: The cartel slips away with the pristine harvest while {role:food_trust} burns empty chaff and collects millions in disaster relief.

loose_threads.detail: Thermal scans of the disposal incinerator show no organic ash signatures despite forty recorded burn cycles.
Disaster insurance claims were pre-approved by the agrarian ministry six days before the blight was reported.

radio_hooks: Agricultural inspectors in {system} confirm fifty thousand tons of condemned wheat earmarked for burn.
Grain futures jump fourteen percent as {role:food_trust} warns of regional starch shortfalls.
Dock unions in {system} demand safety gear before unloading alleged blight silos.

voice_direction.farm_inspector: Flat, relentless, speaking with monotonous bureaucratic precision that hides intense personal fury. Never raises their voice.
voice_direction.rogue_agronomist: Nervously witty, over-explaining plant biology whenever pressed on inventory records. Changes the subject constantly.
